user.title: Set up AV Scenes
user.description: After setup, add rooms, devices and activities via "Configure".

add_room.title: Add room
add_room.description: Pick a Home Assistant area or enter a name. The editor for the new room opens next.

delete_room.title: Delete room
delete_room.description: The room is deleted with all its devices and activities.

edit_room.title: Room "{room}"
edit_room.description:
Devices, activities and steps as YAML. Step types: `power_on`, `power_off`, `set_source`, `set_volume`, `set_sound_mode`, `set_brightness`, `set_color_temp`, `set_position`, `set_tilt`, `call_action`, `delay`, `wait_available`. `on_start` and `on_stop` take any Home Assistant actions. Example:

```yaml
name: Wohnzimmer
devices:
  onkyo:
    entity_id: media_player.onkyo_receiver
    power_switch: switch.steckdose_multimedia
    ready: {timeout: 60, reload_integration: true, on_timeout: abort}
  beamer:
    entity_id: media_player.epson_ehtw7400
    power_switch: switch.steckdose_beamer
    ready: {timeout: 60, reload_integration: true, on_timeout: continue}
    delay_after_off: 180
activities:
  tv:
    name: TV
    devices: [onkyo, beamer]
    steps:
      - {type: set_source, device: onkyo, source: SAT}
      - {type: set_volume, device: onkyo, volume_level: 0.35}
    on_start:
      - action: cover.close_cover
        target: {area_id: wohnzimmer}
```

edit_all.title: Whole configuration
edit_all.description: All rooms as YAML – handy for backups, copying or larger changes.

error.name_required: Please pick an area or enter a name
error.room_exists: A room with this name already exists

start_activity.name: Start Activity
start_activity.description: Starts an activity in a room

activity.name: Activity
activity.description: The name of the activity to start

stop_activity.name: Stop Activity
stop_activity.description: Stops the current activity in a room

toggle_activity.name: Toggle activity
toggle_activity.description: Stops the running activity of a room, or starts one – the last used one if none is given.

activity.name: Activity
activity.description: Optional: activity to start when nothing runs in the room

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Sends a remote control command (e.g. volume_up, channel_down, ok) to the device the running activity routes it to.

command.name: Command
command.description: volume_up, volume_down, mute, volume_set, channel_up, channel_down, play_pause, play, pause, stop, next, previous, up, down, left, right, ok, back, menu, home, info, guide, exit – or a name from `commands`

value.name: Value
value.description: Value for the command, e.g. 0.4 for volume_set

device.name: Device
device.description: Optional: send to this device instead of the routed one; works while nothing runs

missing_entity.title: AV Scenes: entity {entity_id} is missing
missing_entity.description: In room **{room}**, `{path}` refers to `{entity_id}`. This entity does not exist in Home Assistant – it was probably renamed or removed. Fix the entry in the AV Scenes configuration.

activity_aborted.title: AV Scenes: start of "{activity}" aborted
activity_aborted.description:
In room **{room}**, the start of activity **{activity}** was aborted:

`{reason}`

Check that the device has power and its integration loads, or raise `timeout` or set `on_timeout: continue`. This message disappears with the next start or stop of the room.

no_activity.message: Nothing runs in room "{room}", so there is no device for "{command}"

unknown_command.message: No device in room "{room}" handles the command "{command}"

command_timeout.message: Command "{command}" did not finish in time ({target})
